name: Channelome exhaustive hunt (everything, one run)
description: The all-in-one app-level hunt for one scope: Compara paralogue mine across the species panel, ortholog expansion of every unnamed locus found, InterPro enumeration of the scope's signatures, merge and dedupe, then every analysis — MSA, identity matrix, NJ tree, discovery scoring with the sister-family test, presence/absence matrix — and a full bundle. Scope it (`--scope kir`, `--scope cysloop`); running it at `all` means enumerating the whole P-loop superfamily and will take hours. The publication-grade census is the roadmap's S2-S5, not this.
